raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced a Wikidata result (Q235609) with an incorrect death year in the snippet (showing 1896) for Princess Elisabeth of Saxe-Altenburg, confusing identities among multiple “Princess Elisabeths” and not verifying by opening the source. This reliance on an unverified search snippet could directly lead to an incorrect death date instead of the correct 24 March 1927.
